name: parkping
description: ParkPing - the digital doorbell for cars. Privacy-oriented vehicle alerting.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @parkping/shared && npm run build -w @parkping/api && npm run build -w @parkping/web && npm run build -w @parkping/admin
scripts.test: npm run test -w @parkping/shared && npm run test -w @parkping/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @parkping/shared && npm run typecheck -w @parkping/api && npm run typecheck -w @parkping/web && npm run typecheck -w @parkping/admin
